newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB leaves discount rate at 1.00 pct after meeting.
newsitem.headline: SNB leaves discount rate at 1.00 pct after meeting.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said it was leaving its discount rate unchanged at 1.00 percent after a regular weekly meeting of its central bank council.
"No change," an SNB spokesman said in response to an enquiry.

Financial markets were waiting for the results with more interest than usual, after the SNB on Wednesday said it was adding significant amounts of liquidity to the market to counteract the Swiss franc's rise.
But most traders had not expected a rate cut today. At the current 1.00 percent level, the discount rate matches the historic low maintained from February 1978 to November 1979.
The rate was last changed September 26, 1996 when it was lowered from 1.50 percent.
